title: Brain tumors cfRNA sequencing data, meningioma subset

publications.title: Diagnostic and prognostic potential of cell-free RNAs in cerebrospinal fluid and plasma for brain tumors

needs_manual_review_reason: NEW RECORD (2026-07-11), from a discovery-log LEAD reporting 89 total BioSamples with several labeled 'meningioma patient plasma sample' (SLiPiR-seq cfRNA sequencing), in a mixed cohort with glioma and tumor-free controls. Independently re-verified live via the NGDC BIG Search API, NOT trusting the log's framing: a full unpaginated pull of all BioSamples under PRJCA024570 (https://ngdc.cncb.ac.cn/search/api/specific?db=biosample&q=PRJCA024570&length=300) returns 159 total unique BioSamples (not 89; the log's '89 total BioSamples' appears to have actually been the meningioma-only count, mislabeled as the project total), with descriptions breaking down as: 46 'meningioma patient plasma sample' + 43 'meningioma patient CSF sample' = 89 meningioma-labeled biosamples (confirmed independently, matches the log's number exactly once correctly interpreted as the meningioma subset, not the project total); 18 'glioma patient plasma sample' + 16 'glioma patient CSF sample' = 34 glioma-labeled; 18 'tumor-free CNS disease patient plasma sample' + 18 'tumor-free CNS disease patient CSF sample' = 36 tumor-free-control biosamples. 46+43+34+16+18+18 = 159, confirming the arithmetic is internally consistent. patient_count set to 46 (the plasma-sample count, assumed 1 plasma draw per patient) and sample_count set to 89 (plasma+CSF biosamples combined) since 43 of the 46 patients also had a paired CSF biosample; this is a Medium-confidence inference (some patients may have 2 biosamples, others may have only 1, exact 1:1 plasma:patient mapping not independently confirmed at the per-subject level) -- flagged for follow-up verification of exact per-patient sample counts. The parent BioProject additionally contains 34 glioma-labeled and 36 tumor-free-control biosamples NOT counted in this record's patient_count/sample_count, since this record is deliberately scoped to only the meningioma-labeled subset of a genuinely mixed multi-disease cohort (a textbook case of 'meningioma hidden inside a differently-titled/mixed project'). MODALITY: SLiPiR-seq is a cell-free RNA (cfRNA) sequencing method; controlled_vocabulary.md has no dedicated cfRNA-specific term, so 'bulk_rna_seq' was used as the closest existing fit per instruction, flagged here as a possible controlled-vocabulary gap (a future 'cfrna_seq' term, analogous to how 'cfdna_epigenomic' was added for cfDNA methylation, may be warranted). Located and verified a genuine linked publication independently via the BioProject page and cross-checked via PubMed esummary: Huang et al., 'Diagnostic and prognostic potential of cell-free RNAs in cerebrospinal fluid and plasma for brain tumors', NPJ Precision Oncology 2025, PMID 40301505, DOI 10.1038/s41698-025-00909-6, last author Gou D (matches the BioProject's submitter contact, Deming Gou, Shenzhen University) -- this paper's title covers 'brain tumors' broadly (including this project's meningioma arm) and is a genuine peer-reviewed primary reference, so peer_reviewed is set to true. Per the recurring-mistake guardrail on this project: although the paper's title says 'prognostic potential', has_outcome_data is set to false (not true) because no meningioma-specific survival/recurrence-free-survival data was confirmed at the BioSample-metadata level examined here; the title alone does not confirm outcome data exists for the meningioma subset specifically. Only public NGDC BioProject/BioSample-level metadata and PubMed metadata were used; no restricted sequencing data was accessed.
